user.title: Connect to LuxCloud
user.description:
Enter your **LuxPower cloud account** credentials and inverter details.

Don't have an account? Download the **LuxPower** app (iOS / Android) and register for free, then add your inverter using the serial number on the label.

data_description.username: The email address you use to log in to the LuxPower app or web portal.
data_description.serial_number: Printed on the label on the side of your inverter — typically 10 characters, e.g. `2312XXXXXXXX`. Also visible in the LuxPower app under Device → Info.
data_description.region: Choose **EU** if your inverter is registered on the European server (eu.luxpowertek.com), otherwise choose **Global**.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate LuxCloud
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Please re-enter your credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure LuxCloud
reconfigure.description: Update your credentials, serial number, or server region.

data_description.serial_number: Printed on the label on the side of your inverter.
data_description.region: Choose **EU** if your inverter is on the European server, otherwise **Global**.

error.invalid_auth: Incorrect username or password. Please check your LuxPower app credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the LuxPower server. Check your internet connection or try the other region.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs for details.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force an immediate data refresh from the LuxCloud API.
